title: Connected-data CPF coverage with SendUnitData
purpose: Add a distinct connected-data parser entry point using the documented SendUnitData command and the documented CPF pair of Connected Address Item plus Connected Data Item, improving frame-shape diversity beyond discovery and unconnected explicit messaging.

messages.label: SendUnitData with Connected Address Item and Connected Data Item

expected_behavior: After session registration, the second message should be parsed as SendUnitData with a valid connected-address/connected-data CPF layout. Because no prior ForwardOpen is established in the supplied evidence, ordinary connection-related rejection or other benign protocol error handling is acceptable after successful parsing.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length 0x0016 matches the 22-byte payload after the 24-byte header.
Six zero command-specific bytes are present before CPF.
First CPF item is Connected Address Item type 0x0100 with length 4 and a 4-byte connection identifier placeholder.
Second CPF item is Connected Data Item type 0x00B1 with length 6.
Inner connected-data bytes are bounded and internally consistent rather than claiming application success.
Session handle 0x01000000 is a negotiated-handle placeholder to be replaced by the harness when replaying statefully.
issue_safety_notes: Safe connected-data coverage only. No attempt is made to fake a real ForwardOpen-created connection or to reproduce any historical malformed connected-data payload.
